import math

# Monthly outlays for the US Judiciary from Jan 1984 to Mar 1987 (in millions of dollars)
outlays = [
    # 1984
    84, 89, 63, 74, 62, 93, 65, 79, 69, 79, 67, 96,
    # 1985
    66, 60, 59, 119, 75, 63, 74, 103, 66, 98, 74, 102,
    # 1986
    76, 109, 74, 129, 75, 71, 70, 106, 87, 73, 73, 113,
    # 1987 Jan-Mar
    79, 76, 110
]

# Number of months
n = len(outlays)
print(f"Number of months: {n}")
print(f"Data points: {outlays}")

# Calculate geometric mean
product = 1
for val in outlays:
    product *= val

print(f"Product: {product}")
geometric_mean = product ** (1/n)
print(f"Geometric mean: {geometric_mean}")

# Also calculate using natural logs
log_sum = sum(math.log(x) for x in outlays)
gm_from_logs = math.exp(log_sum / n)
print(f"Geometric mean (via logs): {gm_from_logs}")

# Round to nearest thousandth in millions
result = round(geometric_mean, 3)
print(f"Result (rounded to 3 decimal places): {result}")
EOF
